items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: a big place because Louis, my cousin was Louis Prevost, you know.

ctx.x: I know he had just down for the Tencent Storys, I think he had one place.

Yeah, that's where he had a place. Yeah, a big place because Louis, my cousin was Louis Prevost, you know. Oh yeah. He used to play a clarinet and then he was playing with a lyric, playing trumpet. But I used to go sit up there and sit up there with him and eat and drink up there when, at Tom Anderson when Louis Armstrong was playing up there. Cause he used to come bring his cornet. My cousin used to put the clarinet in his pocket. Two pieces in there. Two pieces in each pocket and go up there and play. And I…
Oh, just the bandstand was up high.
